title: Merge Strings Alternately
summary: Combine two strings by alternating characters from each, beginning with the first string.
statement: Combine two strings by alternating characters from each, beginning with the first string. If one string is longer, append the remaining characters of the longer string to the end of the combined string.
constraints: Take one character from word1, then one from word2, repeating while possible.
When one word ends, append the remainder of the other word.
hints: Only the same index from each word is consumed in each round.
Iterate through the longer length and append each available word1 then word2 character.
Bounds-check both words at every index and join the collected characters.
This exactly follows the required alternating order, and the checks append the unmatched suffix unchanged.
